scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:config:local && pnpm run dev:infra && pnpm run dev:migrate && turbo run dev --filter=admin --filter=client --filter=store
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose up -d platform-db store-db traefik api && pnpm run dev:wait-db
scripts.dev:wait-db: until docker exec prepare-os-store-db pg_isready -U postgres -d store > /dev/null 2>&1 && docker exec prepare-os-platform-db pg_isready -U platform -d platform > /dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done
scripts.dev:migrate: pnpm --filter api run db:push && pnpm --filter store run db:push
scripts.dev:docker: pnpm run dev:config:docker && docker compose up -d && pnpm run dev:migrate
